summary: Elaine Stypula, 60, of Michigan, collapsed on the Little Giant Trail near Gold Lake (~12,300 ft) about an hour into the 2025 Hardrock 100 ultramarathon; the Hardrock 100 Safety Sweep Team had CPR in progress when the 9:02 a.m. SAR call came in. Silverton Medical Rescue reached the steep, rugged scene by 4x4 and a quarter-mile hike, performed resuscitation efforts, and the patient was pronounced deceased at 10:27 a.m. Cause of death unknown (investigation ongoing per the release).
location: Little Giant Trail near Gold Lake, Hardrock 100 course east of Silverton
responding_agency: San Juan County Sheriff's Office; Silverton Medical Rescue; Flight for Life
notes: Date = Friday 2025-07-11 (weekday-verified; SMR press release 'Press Release: 7_11_2025' opened this run). Coroner's office identified the 60-year-old female as Elaine Stypula of Michigan. Stypula was an experienced ultrarunner (100+ ultra-distance finishes). iRunFar corroborates the 9:02 a.m. call / 10:27 a.m. death timeline.
